items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I engaged a pianist from Martinique named Pierre Jean Louis... The alto player I engaged was also the Martinique musician named Edouard Pajaniandy... ctx.x: I became acquainted with an Italian name Sergio Sangiorgi whom I later found out was a count and a lover of jazz. I also became acquainted with a bass player named Carlo Loffredo who was president of the Hot Club of Rome and did a concert with the Roman New Orleans Jazz Band of which he was a member. This happened the 10th of April, and featured Arstella Whittier, Big "Boy" Goodie, Armando Travaioli without his big band and Ivan Vandor, a soprano sax man and member of the Roman New Orleans Jazz Band. There was…

Fred Palmer could speak the Italian language quite well and he made the acquaintance of an impressario who had nothing but ideas and this fellow told Fred that he was going to put on a show and wanted to use us. So we started rehearsing at Count Sangiorgi's home with a Martinque musician named Edouard Pajaniandy whom I had met in Paris. He had left an orchestra called Fanfan, who was played at the night club "Rupe Tarpea" in Rome and "Big Boy" had taken Edouard's place in that orchestra. We had an Italian…

The day after the concert which was the 10th of April at the Cinema Theatro Bernini(ntohing to do with the hotel Bernini-Bristol) we taken a bus for Naples where the show was to start. Lily had gone back to Switzerland and was to come back definitely to Rome in 20 days. It was the first time I ever waited that long for a girl to come back to me.
